course.title: 1-4：时域与频域——同一个系统的两种观察视角

inline_ai_visibility.evidence: AI guidance is delivered through the shared page context. Answer checking remains unavailable until every required response key is confirmed or the teacher reveals answers.

static_media_downgrade.evidence: Shared native control workbenches render linked pole, step, Bode and Nyquist views. Static lesson figures remain supporting or fallback evidence.

content_source_completeness.evidence: The accepted interactive page, contract, BOPPPS plan, teacher handout and knowledge-card sequence cover all 12 runtime steps without implementation-authored replacement prose.

submission_confirmation.evidence: Student cards confirm only after persisted state succeeds; failed saves remain retryable and do not reveal answers. Shared state updates and tracking outbox synchronization are serialized.

multi_panel_evidence.evidence: Cumulative page answers are preserved while the current control-workbench draft is sent as the direct event evidence, preventing attribution to an earlier panel.

frequency_answer_visibility.evidence: Student pages keep exact frequency-reading text hidden until the step has a confirmed saved response or the teacher reveals answers. Frequency markers and standard workbench exploration remain available.

blank_control_defaults.evidence: Number and select fields without explicit defaults initialize as blank and block submission until completed. Step 7 uses the shared slider input for the 2 rad/s frequency control.

unique_step_06_evidence_entry.evidence: The closed-loop bandwidth and loop crossover readings are submitted only by their respective compute panels; the activity card records only the definition-relation judgment.

async_panel_submission.evidence: The 1-4 page adapter returns the persistence Promise to the shared workbench. A real deferred-Promise client regression test proves pending double-click lock, failure visibility, retained results and explicit retry.

student_browser.evidence: Entry and key linked-workbench pages rendered without console errors or page-level horizontal overflow. Desktop and mobile Lighthouse accessibility, best-practices, SEO and agentic-browsing scores were 100.

teacher_route.evidence: Unauthenticated teacher and waiting routes redirect to login with the full classroom callback path. Live confirmation and waiting-state failures are covered by component and route tests.

evidence: Course pedagogy review passed after BOPPPS, teacher handout and runtime timing were aligned.
UI flow review passed after failed submissions stopped confirming cards or revealing answers.
Data-governance review passed after direct multi-panel evidence and snapshot-based outbox acknowledgment were verified.
Independent final review found no remaining reproducible blocker.

known_external_issue: The full course-data-quality gate remains blocked only by the existing 1-5 missing response-producing lesson inventory entry; 1-4 is registered and passes its targeted governance checks.
